qs.q: A community health project successfully reduces childhood malnutrition by combining agricultural training, clean water provision, and nutrition education. This outcome validates the principle that:
o: Single-target pharmacological treatments solve all complex public health crises
Health is determined by interconnected socio-environmental and economic factors
Tertiary hospital care is always more effective than primary prevention
Nutritional status depends entirely on individual genetic inheritance
Community participation hinders rapid public health project execution
qs.e: Multi-sectoral interventions prove that health is shaped by interconnected social determinants.
